test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What will be the ratio of simple interest earned by certain amount at the same rate of interest for 8 years and 20 years?
solution:
**Concept used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = [Principal (P) × Rate of interest (R) × Time(T)] / 100

**Calculation:**

Let principal is P, Rate of interest = R

As per the question,

SI₁ : SI₂ = [ (P) × (R) × 8] / 100 : [ (P) × (R) × 20] / 100

⇒ 8 : 20

= 2 : 5

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
